title: geodorum longifolium
intro: Geodorum longifolium, commonly known as the Coral Root or Coral Island Coral Root, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geodorum longifolium involve its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
